documents.text: Sir Henry St John-Mildmay, 4th Baronet Sir Henry St John Carew St John-Mildmay, 4th Baronet (15 April 1787 – 17 January 1848), of Dogmersfield Park, Hampshire, was an English politician. He was the son of Sir Henry St John-Mildmay, 3rd Baronet of Dogmersfield Park and educated at Winchester School (1798-1802) and Christ Church, Oxford (1805). He was a Member of Parliament (MP) for Winchester 1807–1818 and Mayor of Winchester for 1808. He succeeded his father in the baronetcy on 11 Nov. 1808.
